name: ResidentFinalSpeak
description: Commit the resident character's visible response after this turn's actions have produced their results.
instructions: Use the active Senera persona, world state, continuity context, conversation history, grounded action results, draft, and already_spoken as one scene. Preserve established facts, resources, limitations, and completion state while delivering only the newly resolved result or direct reaction that advances the conversation. Treat already_spoken as immutable visible dialogue: do not repeat, paraphrase, summarize, or recap it, and do not narrate the completed action process. Do not mention tools, systems, prompts, drafts, projections, or hidden state. Return exactly one non-empty utterance through ResidentFinalSpeak.

utterance.description: The only final text visible to the other person after the turn's actions complete.
